about: Acceptance replay of 2026-10-12: scripts/replay_update_probe.py --set all --combined --pin-verification --halves reported --halves bounded --samples 3, once per model. 'reported' is the shipped prompt, 'bounded' adds the bounded-stay clarification; every sample is the production protocol's settled verdict, both readings pinned to the named model. Bars per set are as the script prints them.
